title: KTET Result 2026 Out @ktet.kerala.gov.in, Kerala TET December Scorecard PDF Download Link Active
fullContentHtml:
The Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan has officially released the KTET Result 2026 on the official website at ktet.kerala.gov.in. Candidates who appeared for the Kerala TET December Session Exam held on 21st and 23rd February 2026 can download the result PDF. This qualifying exam is to check the eligibility of candidates who want to become teachers in government schools across Kerala. Scroll down to get the direct link to download the KTET Result 2026 for Categories 1, 2, 3, and 4 separately.

KTET Result 2026 Out @ktet.kerala.gov.in

The KTET December Result 2026 has been announced on the official website of the Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan. Candidates who appeared for Categories 1, 2, 3, and 4 can now download their scorecards PDFs online. They have to provide their registration number and date of birth to view the scorecard. The result shows the candidate’s marks, category-wise cutoff, and qualifying status. Candidates who score the minimum qualifying marks will receive the KTET certificate, which is valid for a lifetime as per the latest rules.

Latest Updates 

The Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan has released the KTET Result 2026 on 26th May 2026 on its official website. The result link is active now here.

The KTET Rectified Answer Key 2026 is out on 25th May on ktet.kerala.gov.in. by the Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan. Final key PDF link is Active.

The KTET December Result 2026 has been released for the exam held for the December 2025 cycle. The KTET is conducted for different teaching levels in Kerala schools, including lower primary to higher school teachers. Check more details below.

ktet.kerala.gov.in Result 2026 PDF Download Link

The direct link to check the KTET Result 2026 December scorecard is now available on the official website of Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan. Candidates can log in using their registration number and date of birth to access their scorecard. The scorecard includes marks, qualifying status, and other exam details. Candidates can use the direct result link to quickly download and save their scorecard for future reference.

Note: The KTET Result is out for the December session, whose exam was conducted on 21st and 23rd February 2026.

How to Check the KTET Result 2026?

KTET Result 2026 download is a simple process. Candidates only need their registration number and date of birth to check and download the scorecard. Follow the steps given below

  1. Visit the official website: ktet.kerala.gov.in
  2. Click on the “KTET Result 2026 December” link available on the homepage
  3. Select your category link (Category I, II, III, or IV)
  4. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth
  5. Click on the Submit/Login button
  6. Your KTET Result 2026 scorecard will appear on the screen
  7. Check your marks, qualifying status, and personal details carefully
  8. Download the scorecard PDF and take a printout for future use

Details mentioned on the ktet.kerala.gov.in result 2026 PDF

The KTET Scorecard 2026 includes important details related to the candidate and exam result. Candidates should carefully check all the information mentioned on the scorecard after downloading it. The details mentioned in the KTET Score Card 2026 are given below.

  • Candidate Name
  • Registration Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Category (General / SC / ST / OBC / PH)
  • KTET Category (I / II / III / IV)
  • Exam Date and Session
  • Subject-wise Marks
  • Total Marks Obtained
  • Qualifying Marks
  • Pass or Fail Status
  • Official Seal and Signature of Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan

I Lost my KTET Registration Number, How to Recover?

If you have forgotten your KTET registration number or login details, you can easily recover them online. Candidates need to enter some basic details on the recovery page to get back their login information. Follow the steps below:

  1. Visit the KTET login page
  2. Click on the recovery/forgot password link
  3. Enter details like Applied Educational District, Category, Candidate Name, and Date of Birth
  4. Submit the details carefully
  5. Your login details will be displayed or recovered successfully
  6. Save the details for future use

KTET Qualifying Marks 2026

Candidates must score the minimum marks set by Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan to qualify for the KTET 2026 exam. The qualifying marks is set as per the category. Check the table below for the category-wise qualifying marks of the exam.

Candidate Category Qualifying Percentage Required Marks (Out of 150)
General / Unreserved 60% 90 Marks
OBC / SC / ST 55% 82 Marks
PH (Physically Handicapped) 50% 75 Marks

What After KTET Result 2026 of the December Session?

After the KTET Result 2026 of the December session is declared, candidates should take the next steps carefully for future teaching opportunities.

  • Qualified candidates can apply for teacher posts in Kerala government and aided schools based on their KTET category.
  • Candidates should regularly check the Kerala PSC and education department websites for new teacher recruitment notifications.
  • Qualified candidates must also download or collect their KTET certificate once it is released by Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan.
  • Candidates who could not qualify this time can prepare again and apply in the next KTET exam session.

What is KTET Certificate Validity 2026?

The KTET Certificate 2026 is valid for a lifetime and does not expire. Candidates can use this certificate anytime to apply for teaching jobs in Kerala schools. There is also no limit on the number of attempts in the KTET exam. Candidates can appear again in future sessions to improve their scores if they want.

KTET Result 2026 FAQs

Q. When is the Kerala TET Result 2026 for the December Session released?

Ans: The KTET December Result 2026 has been released on 26 May on the official website.

Q. Where can I download the KTET Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates can download the KTET Result 2026 from ktet.kerela.gov.in.

Q. Can I reappear for KTET if I don’t qualify?

Ans: Yes, candidates who did not qualify in KTET 2026 can again apply and appear for the next KTET session.

Q. What is the validity of the KTET Certificate?

Ans: The KTET Certificate 2026 is valid for a lifetime and does not expire.

Q. What if there is any error in my KTET Certificate 2026?

Ans: Candidates need to contact the Kerala official authorities if they find any errors in their KTET Certificate.

Q. Is the KTET Result 2026 Released Online?

Ans: KTET Result 2026 PDF is now available on the official website of Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan. Candidates can check their results online.

Q. Is Kerala TET Final Answer Key 2026 Out? 

Ans: Yes, Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan released the KTET Answer Key on 25 May 2026. Candidates who appeared on the exam dated 21st & 23rd February 2026. Candidates can download it in PDF format easily.
